firstContext: Word will travel: Haven is clean hands. (Opinion +2 with every village that knows you.)
🗣️ Simen to Klaus, by the fire: "71 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.
